scope: Native Harmonika single-threaded queue and scripted SSE reconnect implementation exams; active backend lifecycle evidence guard correction

roles.Codex: Designed and ran isolated native exams, reproduced the lifecycle completion gap, implemented/tested/activated the correction, independently graded code and reviewed actual reports.
roles.OpenCode: Completed read-only pure plan-mode review of four frozen contract/acceptance files; identified coverage/specification gaps. No Claude invoked.

qa_review.actual_answer_and_report: Nine local tests, unchanged original tests and user edits. Reports virtual-clock round-robin/FIFO, capacity, per-tenant idempotency, lease fencing, cancellation, unknown retaining slot, deep-copy snapshots and mechanical audit. Explicitly disclaims physical workers/GPU, persistence, threading, network and production.
qa_review.root_source_review: Unknown remains ACTIVE, stale ack is refused, reconcile is required to release uncertain capacity. Authoritative completion after cancellation request remains completed; audit contains only four mechanical fields.

qa_review.actual_answer_and_report: Eleven local tests, strict incremental UTF-8, partial-frame buffering, accepted-cursor reconnect, duplicate/stale/foreign filtering and iterator closure. EOF not completed. Explicitly reports scripted iterators rather than live service QA; does not claim external acceptance tests.
qa_review.root_source_review: Fresh decoder per connection, follower cursor independent of decoder id, terminal immutable, bounded reconnect, programmer exceptions propagated and generator closed on early terminal.

backend_fix.reproduced_failure: Cancellation-request, unknown/reconciling/busy and backpressure states were absent from the explicit receipt classifier. A phase=complete decision could cite such receipts as successful evidence.
backend_fix.guidance: Reconcile existing job/worker before assuming cancellation or releasing uncertain physical resources. Respect backpressure budgets. Resume streams using the last accepted event cursor without creating another job.
backend_fix.classification_scope: Only existing explicit top-level receipt state/status and recognized executor metadata; arbitrary source/log/nested application data are not scanned.

acceptance_review.initial_review_timing: Review dispatched before native runs; native execution began while final review was pending.
acceptance_review.independent_grading: Twenty queue and eighteen stream tests generated before native execution; protected files verified by SHA-256. No hidden tests sent to Harmonika.
findings: Per-tenant occupancy with spare global slots was not independently distinguished from round-robin order.
Immediate expiry during full queue, audit privacy/omissions, method-wide clock validation and sequential lease freshness needed coverage.
Numeric cursor ordering, timeout/decode-error reconnects, iterator closure on errors and transition branches needed coverage.
Cancel snapshot return and several precedence/order rules needed explicit wording for future fixtures.
acceptance_review.disposition: Added eight independent follow-up tests per case after initial grading. All sixteen passed against unchanged Harmonika-generated source. Saved reusable probes and clarified contracts for future preparations only. Initial native contracts, hidden acceptance files, source and results were preserved.
acceptance_review.numeric_ordering_note: Original cursor ordering wording did not explicitly say numeric rather than lexical. Follow-up records the implemented numeric behavior; future contract now states it explicitly. No initial run was penalized on an ambiguous requirement.

limits: Queue code is a single-threaded virtual-clock in-memory exam artifact, not a deployed production scheduler, durable broker or GPU worker fencing implementation.
Stream reconnect uses injected byte iterators, not real HTTP/SSE infrastructure or a load/soak test.
Production model probes inspect decisions only; selected client tools are not executed.
Lifecycle guard blocks inappropriate phase=complete evidence and supplies guidance; it is not a universal semantic validator or guarantee of correct free-form answers.
No real user jobs, GPU, financial/CS application, credentials, permissions, TUI binary or branding were changed.
